quotes.quote: MCP tools with a dot in the name (like Backstage's catalog.get-catalog-entity) or a name longer than 41 characters never reached the model. Settings still said "Connected (6 tools)", but the model said the tool did not exist or picked a similar one. The MCP spec allows these names, but OpenAI style tool names do not.
Instead of skipping them, Studio now gives these tools a short valid name and maps it back to the real tool when it is called.
The approach here is right: aliasing the names instead of dropping them, and resolving back to the raw name at dispatch, approval and display.

def test_mcp_specs_skip_oversized_names():
    ...
    specs = _mcp_specs_for_server(server, tools)
    assert len(specs) == 1
    assert specs[0]["function"]["name"].endswith("__ok")
OpenAI's function.name regex; MCP names that violate it would 400 the whole request, so validate up front and skip with a warning.
